verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe two-way GitHub sync: connecting a project to a repo, working on isolated branches, previewing changes, running CI, and publishing via pull requests, plus importing existing GitHub code as a starting point. This covers both directions of the flow (push changes to repo via PRs, and pull/import existing repo code). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the GitHub sync workflow specifically (community evidence covers other aspects of v0, not GitHub sync) and detail on conflict resolution reliability in practice.
